blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Robin Padilla said that he was “happy” to be subpoenaed to answer an obstruction of justice complaint filed against him, adding that he would appear before the Department of Justice (DOJ) prosecutors. A complaint against Padilla has been filed by the Philippine National Police for allegedly aiding the escape of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa in the early morning of May 14.
